subject: general
question:
The following sentence has been divided into parts. One of them may contain an error. Select the part that contains the error from the given options. If you don’t find any error, mark ‘No error’ as your answer.

I had done / my cooking when / Vishnu came to see me.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 2.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The phrase **"I had done"** is incorrect in this context. The correct phrase should be "I had finished" because it better fits the context of completing an action. (मैंने समाप्त कर दिया था)

 
 
• **Example: **I had finished my homework when my friend called me.
 
 
 
• **"Finished" **refers to completing a task or activity. (समाप्त किया)
 
 
• **Example: **She finished her painting just in time for the exhibition.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 2**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **No error **(कोई त्रुटि नहीं): Indicates that the sentence is correct and has no grammatical mistakes.

 
 
• **Example:** No error was found in the final draft of the document.
 
 
 
• **Vishnu came to see me **(विष्णु मुझसे मिलने आए): This part of the sentence is grammatically correct.
 
 
• **Example: **Ravi came to see me after his trip.
 
 
 
• **My cooking when **(मेरा खाना बनाना जब): This part needs to be attached to the rest of the sentence to make complete sense.
 
 
• **Example:** My cooking was almost done when the guests arrived.
